entities.name: PMID:34314129
observations: WHO 2021 guideline prioritizes HPV DNA testing as the primary screening method; VIA/cytology are options where HPV testing is not yet operational.

entities.name: PMID:19339719
observations: In rural India randomized trial, HPV screening reduced advanced cervical cancer and cervical-cancer deaths; VIA did not significantly reduce either outcome versus control.

entities.name: PMID:35225450
observations: Meta-analysis of three trials found VIA associated with lower cervical-cancer mortality (rate ratio 0.68, 95% CI 0.56–0.81); invasive-cancer incidence impact was inconclusive (0.94, 0.67–1.30).

entities.name: PMID:35084291
observations: Diagnostic-accuracy meta-analysis estimated VIA sensitivity 64% and VILI sensitivity 80%; pooled specificity was 88% for both.

entities.name: PMID:17679017
observations: Cluster-randomized Indian trial reported VIA screening reduced cervical-cancer incidence (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.55–0.95) and mortality (HR 0.65, 0.47–0.89) with trained nurses and quality assurance.
